title: Whose Thing Is It?
summary: Put the possessor after the thing and use se pou to say who something belongs to.

sketchBlocks.cardTitle: Put the Owner After the Thing
sketchBlocks.title: Machin mwen, kaye ou
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
To show possession, the possessor follows the thing.

- **machin mwen** — my car
- **kaye ou** — your notebook
- **valiz mesye Jan** — Mr. Jean's bag

Notice the order: **thing + possessor**.

segments.text: To show possession, the possessor follows the thing.

sketchBlocks.title: Se pou…
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Here is another useful way to show who something belongs to with **se pou**.

- **Machin nan se pou mwen.** — The car is mine.
- **Manje a se pou Jan.** — The food is Jan's.
- **Sa se pou yo.** — This/these belong to them.

Use **se pou + person** to identify the owner.

sketchBlocks.cardTitle: Keep the Owner After the Thing
sketchBlocks.title: Possession with singular and plural things
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
The owner still follows the thing when the noun phrase is singular or plural.

- **valiz mwen an** — my bag
- **liv li yo** — his/her books
- **kaye ou yo** — your notebooks

Keep the object first and the possessor after it.
